responsibility: This file implements the non-inline operations of GCC’s fixed-universe sparse set container based on the Briggs-Torczon dense/sparse representation. It allocates the combined dense/sparse storage, supports deletion while preserving iterator correctness, and provides copy, intersection, difference, union, and equality operations over sparseset objects. Its role is the concrete algorithmic implementation for a cache-friendly sparse integer-set abstraction used by analyses that need fast membership tests, insertion/removal, and iteration over relatively sparse sets.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file implements the non-inline sparse-set operations declared in gcc/sparseset.h, such as allocation, deletion with iterator preservation, copying, and set algebra, rather than defining the container layout and inline membership/update/iteration primitives.
